values.note: 2027 season, Rec Park and Gibson Cove: RV $30 a night lake view, $35 lakefront ($210 / $245 a week); tent sites $20. Monthly ($440 / $500) is for seasonal lottery sites only. Visitor vehicles staying overnight $2 a day.

values.note: ReserveAmerica lists 116 sites for Rec Park and Gibson Cove together (102 Standard Electric, 14 tent). Of the 42 Rec Park electric sites read (20 Lakefront loop, 22 Lakeview loop), 36 are back-in and 6 pull-through, with equipment lengths 23 to 57 ft. Seasonal sites are let by an annual lottery.

season.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/clay-county-rec-park/PRCG/1072250/campsites ('SEASON DATES Current Status - Open Through 31 Oct 2026 PEAK 01 Apr 2026 - 31 Oct 2026'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Stays of up to 14 days book on ReserveAmerica ('Reservations for 14-day camp sites can be made using Reserve America'; for longer, a second reservation on a different site). Seasonal sites are let by an annual lottery (the 2027 drawing is 2026-10-24). Check-in 3-10 pm, check-out 1 pm; the front gate is open 7 am to 11:30 pm. 2026 reservations opened March 1.

booking.source: https://www.reserveamerica.com/explore/clay-county-rec-park/PRCG/1072250/overview ('THERE IS A 14-DAY MAXIMUM STAY ON ALL SITES') + 2027 rules and lottery PDFs on campgrounds.claync.us + https://campgrounds.claync.us/ ('Campground Reservations can be made beginning March 1, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

note: Clay County-operated campground on Lake Chatuge near Hayesville; gravel pads, fire rings, beach, playground, pavilions, and a county boat ramp between it and the county's Gibson Cove campground. Some sites are seasonal, let by an annual lottery. --Claude
summary: Confirmed the 2027 county rate sheet ($30 lake view / $35 lakefront) and ReserveAmerica booking; added 50-amp electric and water (sewer cleared: the rules send all wastewater to the dump stations), sites to 57 ft with some pull-throughs, dump and Wi-Fi, Apr 1-Oct 31 season, 14-night maximum. Site count left at 39 (RA lists Rec Park and Gibson Cove together and one page did not load). Note's 'full-hookup (E/W/S)' and field facts dropped.
flags: New lead, not in the database: Gibson Cove Campground (Clay County, 3279 Myers Chapel Rd, Hayesville), the county's second Lake Chatuge campground on the same ReserveAmerica facility, ~40 Standard Electric sites in Lakefront and Lakeview loops at the same 2027 rates.
